name: Corvinus University of Budapest
summary: Budapest business and social-science university; 8 bachelor's taught in English, from economics and data science to PPE and media.

ib.text: The IB Diploma is named as accepted: IB English SL 5 or HL 4 covers the English proof, and Maths SL 5 or HL 4 replaces the maths entrance exam. No GPA or subject minimum; admission is on exam or interview points.

lastYear.text: rolling; exams to 26 May; early bird 26 Jan

programmes.name: Applied Economics
programmes.about: Six-semester economics degree in English on economic concepts, structured model-based thinking and data analysis tools, with mathematics used as a tool; small classes lead on to competitive master's programmes.
programmes.overview: The first year covers introductory economics, empirical methods, calculus, linear algebra and probability, plus business basics and a project. Year two moves to macro and microeconomic theory, accounting, international economics, two econometrics courses, game theory and AI in business. In year three you study corporate finance, public economics, industrial organisation and the history of economic thought while preparing a thesis. Mathematics is taught as a practical tool, and individual and group assignments build presentation skills. Many students go on to a master's; graduates also work as macroeconomic, market or financial analysts and actuaries in companies, banks, insurers and consultancies.
programmes.ib: IB Maths SL 5 or HL 4 replaces the Corvinus maths exam; without it you sit the online 60-minute maths exam.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored out of 100; the Dean sets a points threshold each year. The online maths exam (26 questions) is skipped with IB Maths SL 5 or HL 4.

programmes.name: Business and Management
programmes.about: Seven-semester EFMD-accredited business degree in English covering finance, marketing, accounting, data analysis and business law, with specialisations in year 3 and a compulsory 480-hour internship.
programmes.overview: Year one builds on data analysis, statistics, micro and macroeconomics, accounting and organisational management; year two turns to marketing, corporate finance, managerial accounting, business law, strategy, operations, HR and project management. In year three you choose from 27 specialisations, such as AI-driven management, corporate finance, digital business, entrepreneurship or sustainability management. Teaching uses case studies, group projects and business case competitions, and the final year is a long internship plus thesis. Double-degree routes exist with Kedge Business School in France and EBS in Germany. Graduates work in finance, marketing, HR, project management, controlling, logistics and analytics.
programmes.ib: IB Maths SL 5 or HL 4 replaces the Corvinus maths exam; without it you sit the online 60-minute maths exam.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored out of 100; the Dean sets a points threshold each year. The online maths exam (26 questions) is skipped with IB Maths SL 5 or HL 4.

programmes.name: Business Informatics
programmes.about: Seven-semester degree in English linking business and IT: providing IT solutions to business problems as analyst, developer or project team member, with a compulsory 320-hour internship.
programmes.overview: The first year mixes calculus, linear algebra, probability, economics, programming and an introduction to data science and IT architecture. Year two adds databases, software engineering, AI applications, finance, law, IT project management and business process management. Year three covers intelligent systems, machine learning, ERP systems, business analytics, cybersecurity and digitalisation projects. The course is practice-oriented, with projects done with real companies, case study competitions and a mandatory internship from the fifth semester, followed by a thesis. Graduates work as business systems developers, designers, business intelligence specialists, analysts and IT managers in large firms, financial institutions and startups.
programmes.ib: IB Maths SL 5 or HL 4 replaces the Corvinus maths exam; without it you sit the online 60-minute maths exam.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored out of 100; the Dean sets a points threshold each year. The online maths exam (26 questions) is skipped with IB Maths SL 5 or HL 4.

programmes.name: Communication and Media Science
programmes.about: Six-semester social-science degree in English on communication, sociology, politics and philosophy, with media production in studios, five specialisations and an 80-hour internship.
programmes.overview: The first year pairs communication with philosophy, economics, international politics, quantitative social research and persuasive and visual communication. Year two adds qualitative methods, media literacy, language in culture and society, data visualisation and digital marketing communication. Year three brings project and campaign communication, a compulsory internship and a thesis seminar. Teaching is project-oriented, with media studio work. You choose one of five specialisations: Public Communication, Business Communication, Global Connections and Communications, Community Communication or Global Social Challenges. Graduates work as media specialists, PR experts and social media managers.
programmes.ib: Decided on a 10-15 minute online interview (knowledge, skills, motivation); no maths or subject requirement. IB English SL 5 or HL 4 covers the English proof.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored out of 100 in a 10-15 minute Teams interview on motivation, verbal skills and career plans; the Dean sets a points threshold each year.

programmes.name: Data Science in Business
programmes.about: Eight-semester data science degree in English with strong maths, statistics and programming (Python, SQL, R), practical data-lab projects and about 480 hours of internship; no programming experience needed.
programmes.overview: The first two years build mathematical and statistical foundations (calculus, linear algebra, probability) using Excel and R, with Python and SQL programming taught from scratch, plus economics, accounting, databases, data visualisation and statistical modelling. Later years turn to machine learning, business intelligence and project courses such as data-driven business decisions, worked on corporate datasets in the university's data labs. A long internship and a thesis complete the degree. Exchange places are available through the university's partner network. Graduates work as data analysts, BI consultants, AI specialists and financial analysts.
programmes.ib: IB Maths SL 5 or HL 4 replaces the Corvinus maths exam; without it you sit the online 60-minute maths exam.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored out of 100; the Dean sets a points threshold each year. The online maths exam (26 questions) is skipped with IB Maths SL 5 or HL 4.

programmes.name: International Relations
programmes.about: Six-semester degree in English on diplomacy, global politics, economics and international law, with negotiation and analysis skills, simulations and an 80-hour internship.
programmes.overview: Year one covers philosophy, global history, economics, introductory international relations and social research methods, with training in persuasion and academic writing. Year two adds world economics, post-1945 history, international law and the geopolitics of the USA, UK, Europe and international organisations. Year three covers security studies, global political economy, China, Russia, the Middle East, India and Latin America, with a thesis seminar and a compulsory internship. Teaching uses simulations and case projects, and you choose from six specialisations including European Studies, World Economy and Hungarian Political System. Graduates go into diplomacy, international organisations, NGOs and the international departments of companies.
programmes.ib: Decided on a 10-15 minute online interview (knowledge, skills, motivation); no maths or subject requirement. IB English SL 5 or HL 4 covers the English proof.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored out of 100 in a 10-15 minute Teams interview on motivation, verbal skills and career plans; the Dean sets a points threshold each year.

programmes.name: International Business
programmes.about: Eight-semester cross-cultural business degree in English, project-based with marketing, finance and management, a semester abroad and a compulsory internship.
programmes.overview: The first year covers business essentials, mathematics, micro and macroeconomics, accounting and data analysis; year two adds law, corporate finance, marketing, cross-cultural management and project-based problem solving. Year three turns to international trade practice, negotiation and European business, and a full semester abroad, studying or interning, is part of the course. Teaching is problem-based, with case studies and teamwork in small groups, ending with an internship and thesis. You can concentrate on Global Markets and Marketing, Global Economy and Business, Entrepreneurship, or International Supply Chain Management. Graduates work as trade experts, logistics and sales managers, analysts and consultants, or found their own firms.
programmes.ib: IB Maths SL 5 or HL 4 replaces the Corvinus maths exam; without it you sit the online 60-minute maths exam.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored out of 100; the Dean sets a points threshold each year. The online maths exam (26 questions) is skipped with IB Maths SL 5 or HL 4.

programmes.name: Philosophy, Politics, Economy (PPE)
programmes.about: Six-semester interdisciplinary degree in English joining philosophy, politics and economics, with eight specialisations you choose later and training in analysis, policy and decision-making.
programmes.overview: The first year introduces all three disciplines: logic and moral and political philosophy, comparative politics and political decision-making, and economics, together with research methods and themes such as sustainability and AI. Year two links them through the individual, community and society, advanced political economy and global governance. Year three is for specialised study and two thesis projects. After year two you pick one of eight specialisations, such as Economics and Philosophy, Modern Political Problems or Global Social Challenges, and study abroad is recommended in year three. Graduates work as policy analysts, economic analysts and government relations specialists.
programmes.ib: Both parts must be passed: the maths requirement (IB Maths SL 5 or HL 4 replaces the exam) and then an online interview.
programmes.selectionNote: Two parts, both to be passed: the maths requirement (or exam), then a 10-15 minute interview; scored out of 100 against a yearly threshold set by the Dean.

notes: EEA applicants pay in Hungarian forints, which carries an exchange-rate risk; the fee page quotes non-EEA prices in euros (€6,600-7,000 a year) and EEA prices in HUF.
The 2027/28 application platform opens in October 2026; admissions are rolling, and the 2026 schedule paired application phases with exam deadlines from 8 February to 26 May.
A 10% first-year tuition discount applied in 2026 if you applied by 26 January, passed the exams in February and paid by 31 March.
